# Packages
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, error=TRUE}
# List of required packages
list_of_packages <- c("MASS", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "caret", "rpart", "tidyr", "here", "glmnet" ,"synthpop", "purrr", "MonteCarlo", "tidyverse", "Matrix", "caret", "e1071", "stringr", "tidyr", "bnlearn", "tibble")

# Function to install a package if it is not already installed
install_if_missing <- function(p){
  if(!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)){
    install.packages(p)
  }
  library(p, character.only=TRUE)
}
# Install and load packages
lapply(list_of_packages, install_if_missing)
```

# check data structures
```{r}
# Define the models you expect
prediction_models <- c("bnpred", "cartpred", "svmpred", "parmpred")
synthesis_models  <- c("hiersim", "linsim",         # simulated data
                       "cartlinsyn", "carthiersyn", # CART synthetic
                       "svmlinsyn",  "svmhiersyn",  # SVM synthetic
                       "parmlinsyn","parmhiersyn",  # parametric synthetic
                       "bnlinsyn", "bnhiersyn")     # bn synthetic
 
# find all .RData results files
files <- list.files(path = data_dir, pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
 
# build the exact names we care about
expected_names <- as.vector(outer(prediction_models, synthesis_models, paste, sep = "_"))
expected_files <- paste0(expected_names, ".RData")
 
# report any missing expected files
for (ef in expected_files) {
  if (!ef %in% basename(files)) {
    cat("Missing file:", ef, "\n")
  }
}
 
# only keep the files that match our expected patterns
files <- files[basename(files) %in% expected_files]
 
all_results <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(file_path) {
  fname <- basename(file_path)
  name <- stringr::str_remove(fname, "\\.RData$")
  parts <- stringr::str_split(name, "_", simplify = TRUE)
  pred_model <- parts[1]
  synth_model <- parts[2]
 
  tmp <- new.env()
  load(file_path, envir = tmp)
  obj_name <- ls(tmp)[1]
  res_list <- tmp[[obj_name]]
 
  purrr::map_dfr(names(res_list), function(param_name) {
    param_list <- res_list[[param_name]]
 
    if (!is.list(param_list)) {
      warning("Skipping non-list element ", param_name, " in ", fname)
      return(NULL)
    }
 
    purrr::map_dfr(names(param_list), function(target) {
      df <- param_list[[target]]
 
      if (!is.data.frame(df)) {
        warning("Skipping non-data.frame target ", target,
                " in param ", param_name, " of ", fname)
        return(NULL)
      }
 
      dplyr::mutate(
        df,
        Prediction_Model = pred_model,
        Synthesis_Model = synth_model,
        Parameter_Set = param_name,
        Target = target,
        .before = dplyr::everything()
      )
    })
  })
})
 
combined_long <- all_results |>
  dplyr::select(-Sensitivity) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Accuracy, Specificity, F1, MAE, RMSE, R_squared),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value",
    values_drop_na = TRUE)
```
 
```{r}
# combined_results has columns:
# Prediction_Model, Synthesis_Model, Target, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity
 
combined_filtered <- combined_results %>%
  # drop any missing accuracies
  filter(!is.na(Accuracy)) %>%
  # derive Data_Type from your synthesis model name
  mutate(
    Data_Type = ifelse(str_detect(Synthesis_Model, "hier"), 
                       "hierarchical", 
                       "linear"),
    # tag continuous vs categorical by the Target prefix
    TargetType = ifelse(str_starts(Target, "X"),
                        "Continuous", 
                        "Categorical")
  )
```

```{r}
# Pivot long and tag types
combined_long <- combined_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MAE, RMSE, R_squared, Accuracy, F1, Specificity),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(
    TargetType = ifelse(str_starts(Target, "X"), "Continuous", "Categorical"),
    Data_Type  = ifelse(str_detect(Synthesis_Model, "hier"), "hierarchical", "linear")
  )
 
# Split into the two Metric‐TargetType combos
df_cont <- combined_long %>%
  filter(TargetType == "Continuous", Metric == "RMSE")
 
df_cat  <- combined_long %>%
  filter(TargetType == "Categorical", Metric == "Accuracy")
save(combined_long, file = file.path(data_dir, "combined_long.RData"))
readr::write_csv(combined_long, file = file.path(table_dir, "prediction_results.csv"))
```
 
```{r fig.show='hold', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
 
# fixed colors for Prediction_Model (make sure these match your values)
pred_colors <- c(
  cartpred = "#82c074",
  bnpred   = "#54bdbf",
  parmpred = "#e9496a",
  svmpred  = "#ed9656"
)
 
# metrics to plot
cont_metrics <- c("MAE", "RMSE", "R_squared")
cat_metrics  <- c("Accuracy", "F1", "Specificity")
 
# helpers for pretty labels
metric_title  <- function(m) if (m == "R_squared") "R\u00B2" else m         # title uses R²
metric_ylabel <- function(m) if (m == "R_squared") expression(R^2) else m    # y-axis uses R²
dtype_title   <- function(d) if (tolower(d) == "linear") "parametric" else "hierarchical"
 
# map synthesis model names to unified tick labels
syn_labeller <- function(v) {
  dplyr::recode(v,
    bnlinsyn    = "BN Syn.",
    bnhiersyn   = "BN Syn.",
    parmlinsyn  = "Parametric Syn.",
    parmhiersyn = "Parametric Syn.",
    cartlinsyn  = "CART Syn.",
    carthiersyn = "CART Syn.",
    svmlinsyn   = "SVM Syn.",
    svmhiersyn  = "SVM Syn.",
    hiersim     = "Simulated Data",
    linsim      = "Simulated Data",
    .default    = v
  )
}
 
# canonical order so Simulated Data comes first if present
x_order_canonical <- c(
  "hiersim", "linsim",
  "carthiersyn", "cartlinsyn",
  "parmhiersyn", "parmlinsyn",
  "svmhiersyn", "svmlinsyn",
  "bnhiersyn", "bnlinsyn"
)
 
# which plots keep the legend?
keep_legend_for <- c("R_squared", "Sensitivity")
 
# derive y-axis limits from the boxplot layer
boxplot_y_limits <- function(plot, padding = 0.05,
                             include_outliers = TRUE) {
  box_data <- ggplot_build(plot)$data[[1]]
  y_values <- c(box_data$ymin, box_data$ymax)
  if (include_outliers && "outliers" %in% names(box_data)) {
    y_values <- c(y_values, unlist(box_data$outliers, use.names = FALSE))
  }
  y_values <- y_values[is.finite(y_values)]
  if (length(y_values) == 0) return(NULL)
  limits <- range(y_values)
  y_span <- diff(limits)
  if (y_span == 0) y_span <- max(abs(limits), 1)
  limits + c(-1, 1) * padding * y_span
}
 
# Loop over data types
for (dtype in unique(combined_long$Data_Type)) {
 
  dtype_label <- dtype_title(dtype)
 
  ### Continuous targets ###
  for (metric in cont_metrics) {
 
    dfm <- combined_long %>%
      filter(
        Data_Type  == dtype,
        TargetType == "Continuous",
        Metric     == metric
      )
    if (nrow(dfm) == 0) next
 
    # enforce ordering: simulated data first (if present), then others in fixed order
    present_levels <- intersect(x_order_canonical, unique(dfm$Synthesis_Model))
    dfm <- dfm %>%
      mutate(Synthesis_Model = factor(Synthesis_Model, levels = present_levels))
 
    p <- ggplot(dfm, aes(
      x    = Synthesis_Model,
      y    = Value,
      fill = Prediction_Model
    )) +
      geom_boxplot(
        outlier.shape = 1,
        outlier.size = 0.8,
        alpha         = 1,
        position      = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = pred_colors,
        labels = c(
          cartpred = "CART",
          bnpred   = "BN",
          parmpred = "Parametric",
          svmpred  = "SVM"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = syn_labeller) +
      labs(
        title = NULL, #paste(metric_title(metric), "for Continuous Targets —", dtype_label)
        x     = "Synthesis Model",
        y     = metric_ylabel(metric),
        fill  = "Prediction Model"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
      )
 
    # show the complete boxplot using data-driven limits
    y_limits <- boxplot_y_limits(p, padding = 0.05,
                                 include_outliers = TRUE)
    if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
      p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
    }
    
    # save & print
    fname <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", paste(metric_title(metric), "for Continuous Targets —", dtype_label)),".png"))
    
    ggsave(fname, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
    print(p)
  }
 
  ### Categorical targets ###
  for (metric in cat_metrics) {
 
    dfm <- combined_long %>%
      filter(
        Data_Type  == dtype,
        TargetType == "Categorical",
        Metric     == metric
      )
    if (nrow(dfm) == 0) next
 
    present_levels <- intersect(x_order_canonical, unique(dfm$Synthesis_Model))
    dfm <- dfm %>%
      mutate(Synthesis_Model = factor(Synthesis_Model, levels = present_levels))
 
    p <- ggplot(dfm, aes(
      x    = Synthesis_Model,
      y    = Value,
      fill = Prediction_Model
    )) +
      geom_boxplot(
        outlier.shape = 1,
        outlier.size = 0.8,
        alpha         = 1,
        position      = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = pred_colors,
        labels = c(
          cartpred = "CART",
          bnpred   = "BN",
          parmpred = "Parametric",
          svmpred  = "SVM"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = syn_labeller) +
      labs(
        title = NULL, #paste(metric, "for Categorical Targets —", dtype_label)
        x     = "Synthesis Model",
        y     = metric,
        fill  = "Prediction Model"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
      )
 
    # caps for specificity variants
    if (tolower(dtype) == "hierarchical" && metric == "Specificity") {
      p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1))
    } else if (tolower(dtype) == "linear" && metric == "Specificity") {
      p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.72, 1))
    }
    
    fname <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", paste(metric_title(metric), "for Categorical Targets —", dtype_label)),".png"))
    
    ggsave(fname, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
    print(p)
  }
}
 
```

```{r}
syn_labeller <- function(v) {
  dplyr::recode(v,
    bnlinsyn    = "BN Syn.",
    bnhiersyn   = "BN Syn.",
    parmlinsyn  = "Parametric Syn.",
    parmhiersyn = "Parametric Syn.",
    cartlinsyn  = "CART Syn.",
    carthiersyn = "CART Syn.",
    svmlinsyn   = "SVM Syn.",
    svmhiersyn  = "SVM Syn.",
    hiersim     = "Simulated Data",
    linsim      = "Simulated Data",
    .default    = v
  )
}
 
# Medians for everything used in the plots
medians_all <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(Data_Type, TargetType, Synthesis_Model, Metric, Prediction_Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Synthesis_Label = syn_labeller(Synthesis_Model)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Synthesis_Model)   # drop raw model name
 
# order columns
medians_all <- medians_all %>%
  relocate(Data_Type, TargetType, Synthesis_Label,
           Metric, Prediction_Model, Median)
 
# Save full medians table (for reproducible reporting) ---
write.csv(medians_all, file = file.path(table_dir, "medians_all_for_plots.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
medians_all
```
